f_shim_v5_2.statement: shim v5 with consciousness_states=None produces logits within max_abs_diff <= 1e-5 vs shim v4 reference (cross-attn bypass invariant)
f_shim_v5_2.interpretation_vs_spec_expectation: Spec said 'F-SHIM-V5-2: max_abs_diff > 1e-5 (regression EXPECTED)' anticipating the differential to leak through. EMPIRICALLY this did NOT happen and PASS at exact 0.0 is the CORRECT outcome: F-SHIM-V5-2 forwards both shims with consciousness_states=None, which triggers the DecoderBlockV2 bypass guard so cross_attn.o_proj is NEVER READ regardless of its std value. The bypass invariant is preserved by design. The spec's expected-FAIL prediction was a category error -- a bypass path cannot leak weights it does not consume. The actual differential is observable in the post-apply o_proj_std fields (v4=0.02 vs v5=0.10), not in bypass logits.
f_shim_v5_2.spec_expected_fail_realised_pass_explana: category-error in spec; PASS is the correct outcome on bypass path

f_shim_v5_3.statement: shim v5 with canonical_zero fixture ([1, 8, 192] zeros) is finite AND |lift_pp| (argmax disagreement proxy) < 5pp on calibration prompts
f_shim_v5_3.interpretation: On canonical_zero fixture, shim v5 produces logits BIT-IDENTICAL to no-fixture forward (max abs lift = 0.0, argmax disagreement = 0pp). Cross_attn(Q, zeros, zeros) = 0, so o_proj @ 0 = 0 contributes nothing regardless of o_proj std. Spec section 3 V5-3 expectation matches reality: canonical_zero is INERT under any o_proj scale. Real (non-zero) fixture required to surface differential lift -- this is what F-SHIM-V5-4 H100 spend will probe.

differential_evidence.loaded_note: When best.pt is loaded, _load_decoder_state OVERWRITES the post-apply re-init with trained weights (~0.02), so v4 == v5 by design. The differential is INIT-TIME -- which is what V5-4 will probe via fresh-init or via swapping cross_attn.o_proj weights from a fixture with v5's higher init scale.

vs_phase2_original_finding: Phase 2 original verdict §C3 (state/clm_v4_hf_format_shim_v5_phase2_2026_05_05/verdict.json) found shim v4 and shim v5 EMPIRICALLY IDENTICAL at fresh init (both ~0.02 std). OPT-A re-anchor RESOLVES this: v5 is now ~0.10 (5x v4's ~0.02). The phantom equality is gone. Phase 3 H100 spend on F-SHIM-V5-4 with a real (non-zero) fixture is now expected to produce a measurable differential lift (cross-attn output scales linearly with o_proj std).
honest_c3: C1 -- OPT-A re-anchor std 0.10 produces a 5x differential vs shim v4 fresh-init (v5_mean=0.10001 vs v4_mean=0.01999). The phantom-equality finding from Phase 2 verdict §C3 is RESOLVED at the substrate level. Boot-time assertion fires `[shim-v5][OPT-A] post-apply re-init verified: 16/16 modules at std~0.1000` on every _build_decoder_module call, ensuring future regressions are caught immediately.

C2 -- F-SHIM-V5-2 PASS at max_abs_diff=0.0 is CORRECT despite spec's expected-FAIL prediction. The selftest's F-SHIM-V5-2 forwards with consciousness_states=None, which engages the DecoderBlockV2 bypass guard so cross_attn.o_proj weights are not read. The spec's expected-FAIL was a category error: a bypass path cannot exhibit weight-driven differential. The bypass invariant is preserved exactly as designed.

C3 -- F-SHIM-V5-3 PASS at lift_pp_proxy=0.0pp confirms canonical_zero residual is exactly zero regardless of o_proj scale, matching spec section 3 V5-3 expectation. This is INDEPENDENT of OPT-A re-anchor (any o_proj std produces the same canonical_zero verdict because zero fixture residue makes cross_attn output zero). F-SHIM-V5-4 needs a non-zero (real) fixture to probe the differential.

C4 -- When best.pt is loaded, _load_decoder_state OVERWRITES the post-apply re-init with trained weights (v4=0.01990, v5=0.01990 -- identical because they share the same checkpoint). This means F-SHIM-V5-4 must use either (a) fresh-init forward path with best.pt's NON-cross-attn weights only, OR (b) swap the cross_attn.o_proj sub-block from a v5-init donor while keeping the rest of best.pt. Phase 3 spec needs an explicit decision here -- the current shim v5 OPT-A behavior alone does not preserve the v5 differential under best.pt load. RECOMMENDATION: when V5-4 launches on H100, instrument the eval to ALSO log cross_attn.o_proj.weight.std() at forward time so the actual scale used during the lift measurement is verifiable.

C5 -- Boot-time assertion correctness: the assertion runs INSIDE _build_decoder_module AFTER post-construction re-init AND BEFORE _load_decoder_state can overwrite. This is the only window where the OPT-A re-anchor is observable. After best.pt load, re-running the assertion would (correctly) FAIL because trained weights are at ~0.02 not ~0.10. Callers MUST NOT re-invoke the assertion on a model that has been through _load_decoder_state -- this is documented in the function docstring.

C6 -- ubu1 cpu fp32 was used for both runs (matching Phase 2 original methodology). RTX 5070 sm_120 cuda fp32 was NOT tested in this re-anchor; the byte-equivalent invariant of F-SHIM-V5-2 holds at the algorithmic level (bypass = no weight read) regardless of device, but ULP drift may affect F-SHIM-V5-3 std ratios on cuda. This is acceptable because the differential evidence (o_proj_std fields) is INIT-time and device-agnostic.

C7 -- Phase 3 GO recommendation rationale: the OPT-A blocker from Phase 2 verdict §C3 is RESOLVED. v5 differs from v4 by 5x at fresh init. F-SHIM-V5-4 ($1-3 H100, lift_pp >= +5pp on hellaswag-200 with a real fixture) can now distinguish v5 from v4 IF the eval path uses fresh-init OR a fixture-swap protocol that preserves the v5 init. The default V5-4 path (best.pt loaded) collapses v5 to v4 via _load_decoder_state -- this is a Phase-3-design issue, not an OPT-A regression. Recommend Phase 3 with EXPLICIT eval-protocol clarification.

C8 -- raw#15 additive compliance: shim v4 (tool/transient_py/clm_v4_hf_format_shim.py) was NOT touched -- only shim v5 (sibling file) modified. The boot-time assertion is purely additive (new function _assert_o_proj_std_after_apply, called from existing _build_decoder_module). No upstream conscious_decoder.py mutation.

phase_3_recommendation_detail.caveat: Phase 3 spec must clarify the eval protocol: best.pt loading collapses v5 to v4 (trained weights overwrite post-apply re-init). Two viable V5-4 designs:

v5_4_design_options_ranked.option: DESIGN-1: fresh-init forward path (no best.pt load) on hellaswag-200
v5_4_design_options_ranked.approach: Run hellaswag eval on a fresh-init shim v5 model and a fresh-init shim v4 model. Both will be untrained (random weights), so absolute scores will be near chance, but the DIFFERENTIAL between v5 and v4 directly measures the o_proj std lever. Cost: $1-3 H100.
v5_4_design_options_ranked.drawback: absolute lift_pp is meaningless (random model); only differential is meaningful

v5_4_design_options_ranked.approach: Load best.pt into shim v4 baseline, then ALSO load best.pt + scale cross_attn.o_proj weights by 5x (or replace with shim v5 fresh-init values) in a v5-equivalent variant. Run hellaswag-200 on both. lift_pp = v5_variant - v4_baseline directly answers Phase 3 question.
v5_4_design_options_ranked.completion: MEDIUM (more code surface, requires careful weight injection)
v5_4_design_options_ranked.drawback: introduces weight-injection step that needs F-SHIM-V5 audit

v5_4_design_options_ranked.approach: Use shim v5 fresh-init (no best.pt) + real fixture (e.g., train_avg_real.pt) and compare to shim v4 fresh-init + same real fixture. Bypasses best.pt overwrite entirely. Lower cost than DESIGN-1 (no benchmark, just logits diff).
v5_4_design_options_ranked.completion: MEDIUM (cheap differential probe but no benchmark anchor)
v5_4_design_options_ranked.drawback: no benchmark lift, only intermediate logits diff
